plugins.name: HTTP / HTTPS / SOCKS Proxy
plugins.author: SiloCityLabs
plugins.description: Routes outbound indexer and metadata HTTP through a standard HTTP, HTTPS, or SOCKS5 proxy.

plugins.name: Jellyfin Notifier
plugins.author: SiloCityLabs
plugins.description: Refreshes Jellyfin after Replacearr imports media. Configure inbound_webhook_secret and point Jellyfin's webhook plugin at POST /api/v1/webhooks/jellyfin for jellyfin.picked_up events.

plugins.name: OpenVPN SOCKS Proxy
plugins.author: SiloCityLabs
plugins.description: Exposes a local SOCKS5 URL for outbound traffic; optionally launches OpenVPN (requires CAP_NET_ADMIN).

plugins.name: Replacearr Torznab Demo Indexer
plugins.author: SiloCityLabs
plugins.description: Reference Go indexer plugin demonstrating the zero-CGO Replacearr Plugin SDK over stdin/stdout JSON-RPC. Returns demo releases only.

plugins.name: Webhook Notifier
plugins.author: SiloCityLabs
plugins.description: POSTs Replacearr lifecycle events as JSON to a webhook URL. Use as a template for Telegram, Signal, and other channel plugins.
